summary: 管理收入确认与结算/合同条款只读配对核对首片 on BASE c640a1c. Added pmo_plugins/management_revenue/pairing_read_services.py with two read-only interfaces. revenue_pairing_snapshot(member, *, project_id=None, period=None, as_of=None) derives, per project or as an aggregate with per-project rows: contract_value (approved contract line net via contracts.approved_contract_totals), recognized (posted RevenueRecognition net minus posted RevenueAdjustment via the management-revenue owner export, with a read-only line-level fallback when the owner export needs a missing accounting event), settled (active Settlement gross via settlement_snapshot), unsettled (active OpenItem gross minus active Clearance), cash_coverage (active Clearance total), difference (recognized-settled), contract_variance (contract_value-recognized), terminated flag/terminated contract refs, and capped recognition/settlement refs. revenue_pairing_issues(member, *, as_of=None) returns issue_code/refs/expected/actual for recognized_over_contract_line, recognition_source_invalid, recognized_after_termination, settlement_source_invalid, settlement_after_termination, settlement_without_recognition, settled_exceeds_recognized, terms_without_recognition, cross_project_reference, cross_org_reference and duplicate_recognition. Permissions are owner/finance/auditor full, PM only managed projects, member denied; the new history_read route revenue-pairing renders a read-only page (project/period/as_of filters, unknown params rejected 400) and stays readable when management_revenue is disabled, with no POST/write entry. No model, migration, canonical schema, write path or business fact is changed; the service writes no audit, receipt, event or fact. Gold: contract net 100000, recognized 60000, active settlement 40000, open item 40000 with 30000 active clearance => snapshot recognized/settled/unsettled(10000)/cash(30000)/difference(20000)/variance(40000) and issues=[]; anomaly fixtures (all INSERT-only/legal service transitions, no UPDATE/DELETE of history) hit over-cap recognition, settlement without recognition, recognition/settlement after termination, cross-project and settled-exceeds-recognized issues. Final merged BASE a352b4a (PH-302 integrated) and reviewer round-1 fix: a denied/unreadable settlement_snapshot is no longer silently skipped; the settlement reader now returns (readable rows, missing rows), and when any active settlement snapshot is denied the per-project and aggregate settled/unsettled/cash/difference values are null with settlement_missing/missing markers and a settlement_unreadable issue, and the page renders 缺失 instead of 0. Service and HTTP regressions patch settlement_snapshot to raise PermissionDenied. Final runs: projectctl check ok/task_count=229; scoped 11 tests OK; full suite Ran 1090 tests in 135.179s with exactly the known 8 macOS baseline failures (5F+3E/69 skips); fresh SQLite verify ok; verify-change --base a352b4a --task PH-284 waits only for the reviewer round-2 pass.

deviations: 金额口径：contract_value 使用批准条款净额（management revenue 口径）；settled 使用 active Settlement gross（含税）；recognized 为 posted RevenueRecognition 净额减 posted 调整；三者差异仅展示不调整，report 披露。
unsettled = active OpenItem gross − active Clearance；cash_coverage = active Clearance 合计；未使用任何可编辑余额。
management revenue owner export 在测试/历史事实缺少 accounting_event 时会抛错，服务回退为同权限范围的只读 RevenueRecognition/RevenueAdjustment 行级投影（不写、不建接口）。
Settlement/OpenItem/Clearance 聚合使用只读模型查询（settlement owner 无按项目清单接口，逐条仍经 settlement_snapshot 读取）；不复制业务表为可编辑余额。
pm 只读其管理项目：项目列表/详情过滤 manager=member；若 settlement_snapshot 因角色拒绝则展示 0/缺失并披露，不伪造。
duplicate_recognition 受 DB OneToOne/唯一约束在正常路径不可达，但代码保留检测；未写可选 generic viewed audit 以保持零副作用。
无模型/迁移/canonical topic/command/schema 变更；不改收入/结算/合同写路径；反例全部 INSERT-only/合法服务迁移，不 UPDATE/DELETE 历史。
